objective: Correct the rejected canonical resume implementation so a real busy rejection is detected from live PTY output even while the stdin keeper remains alive, and retry begins only after a gap-free deterministic bound-rollout state change.
operator_policy_constraints: Codex enabled with configured model and reasoning effort
relevant_context: The rejected implementation uses tail -f /dev/null to hold the PTY stdin open. The shell process therefore need not exit when Codex rejects resume as busy.
BUSY_PATTERN is currently evaluated only from buffered output in the child exit handler, so a real busy rejection can hit the confirmation timeout and become UNCERTAIN.
Detect the busy pattern as output arrives, while the rollout watcher remains the authoritative positive confirmation path. A positive rollout confirmation always wins if already observed.

The dispatcher currently closes its pre-scan observation before delivery and registers a new opportunity watcher after a busy result. Close this observation gap without allowing Opsle's own wake-file writes to create an immediate retry loop.
Prefer a bound-rollout watcher registered before checking an exact ordinal or file-size baseline, followed by an immediate check that closes subscription races.
Hash exact complete JSONL line bytes rather than reserialized parsed objects when recording rollout confirmation where practical.
Preserve the canonical exact message, exact argv, process-group cleanup, authority and generation fences, uncertain no-replay behavior, and pause-after-current correction.
